dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetric 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle, creating a smooth parabolic taper.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are largely smooth and symmetrical; no significant localized bulges or indentations are visible along the water-skin interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Slate light-grey with a distinct bluish hue; intensity is consistent with a juvenile or sub-adult pigment phase, well below mature white reflectance.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: High-frequency, low-contrast mottling distributed across the dorsal surface, manifesting as subtle, darker-grey irregularly shaped clusters.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between the baseline slate-grey and the darker mottled clusters, lacking sharp edges.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Several minute, high-contrast white punctate marks are visible on the anterior dorsal surface near the blowhole.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A faint, light-colored linear streak is visible along the central longitudinal axis in the posterior third of the body.
other_distinctive_markers: The blowhole is clearly visible as a high-contrast, dark circular aperture at the anterior end of the visible dorsal plane.
